caption.text:
Sometimes the hardest thing to believe is that what’s meant for you doesn’t require you to chase it. That you don’t have to prove your worth, overextend your heart, or hold onto something that keeps slipping through your hands. But what is real, what is rooted, will meet you in peace — not in confusion, not in pressure. 

We spend so much time questioning why things didn’t work, why doors closed, why something we wanted so badly didn’t stay. But not everything that leaves is a loss. Some things leave because they were never meant to remain — they were only there to teach you, shape you, or redirect you. 

Even when it feels quiet, even when nothing seems to be happening, life is still moving things into place. The right people, the right timing, the right opportunities — they are finding their way to you in ways you cannot always see yet. 

You are not being overlooked. You are being prepared. So keep your heart open, even when it’s hard. What is meant for you will not pass you by — it will find you, and when it does, it will feel like peace. 🖤

📚 Read more in the book ‘Stay Single’ by Rebecca Simon
